title: Gorensteinness with locally Noetherian fibres is fppf local on the target and syntomic local on the source
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter duality.tex (Duality for Schemes)
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file duality.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that the property P(f) = the fibres of f are locally Noetherian and f is Gorenstein is local in the fppf topology on the target and local in the syntomic topology on the source (statement lines 6843-6849). The proof writes P = P_1 and P_2 with P_1 the flatness of f and P_2 the condition on the fibres, notes that P_1 is fppf local on source and target by Descent, Lemmas labelled descent-lemma-descending-property-flat and descent-lemma-flat-fpqc-local-source, and reduces to P_2 (proof lines 6851-6862). For fppf locality on the target it takes an fppf covering Y_i -> Y with base changes f_i, a point y_i over y, writes X_{i,y_i} = Spec(kappa(y_i)) x_{Spec(kappa(y))} X_y and notes that kappa(y_i)/kappa(y) is finitely generated, so local Noetherianity of the fibre passes by Varieties, Lemma labelled varieties-lemma-locally-Noetherian-base-change and Gorensteinness passes by Lemma labelled lemma-gorenstein-base-change (proof lines 6864-6880). For syntomic locality on the source it takes a syntomic covering X_i -> X and notes that for each y the induced family X_{i,y} -> X_y is a syntomic covering of the fibre, so the assertion follows from Lemma labelled lemma-gorenstein-local-syntomic (proof lines 6882-6889). Splitting the property into flatness and the fibre condition, and reducing the fibre conditions to the two cited base change and syntomic locality results, is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
